headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, JSA act on TruNativ $30 million Series B fundraise
sum: Tru Native F&B Private Limited, dba TruNativ, has raised $30 million from a Series B fundraise led by Orbimed. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised TruNativ on this fundraise.
detail: Tru Native F&B Private Limited, dba TruNativ, has raised $30 million from a Series B fundraise led by Orbimed. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised TruNativ on this fundraise. The transaction team consisted of Navruz Vakil (Partner), Daksh Hemnani (Senior Associate), Vidhhii Shah (Associate) and Alena Advani (Consultant). Navruz Vakil JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised OrbiMed Asia V Mauritius Limited on this fundraise.
